spanish: Y harás travesaños maderas de acacia, cinco a tablas de costado del tabernáculo el uno.

findings.issue: שִׁטִּים is feminine plural; Spanish acacia is singular. Species name as material, without a change of referent.

notes: Y harás, travesaños, maderas, cinco, a tablas, costado, del tabernáculo, and el uno match the remaining tokens in person, number, stem, definiteness, and order.
